title: benchmarks run manifest, schema version 1
description: runs/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<campaign>/manifest.json: everything needed to reproduce one run (golden rule 11). tools/validate_run.py enforces this file with a stdlib interpreter of the keywords it uses, then checks what JSON Schema cannot (the directory name, tag/field agreement, file hashes, seeds and ##PROV## lines in the data). A field change bumps schema_version.

campaign.description: The campaign id: the run directory is <date>-<campaign>.

date.description: The UTC date the campaign was dispatched (YYYY-MM-DD).

base_image.description: The ns3-dev image the campaign image is built FROM: the immutable versioned tag and its digest (golden rules 11 and 13: the optimized profile).

ns3_version.description: The ns-3 release in the tag.

profile.description: Benchmarks run on the optimized image (golden rule 13).

campaign_image.description: The image every cell pulled by digest: a campaign image <repo>-ns3-campaign:<commit7>-<basesha7> or <commit7>-<basesha7>-optimized (the tag reusable-ns3-image.yml pushes), or a release image <repo>-ns3:<version>-optimized (swarm-routing/.github#107).

modules.description: Every ns-3 module built into the campaign image, at the commit built: the protocols under test, swarm-core, routing-bench and each arm the plan names.

name.description: The contrib module name (e.g. routing-bench, swarm-core, ara).

harness.description: The program that printed the marker lines and the module that holds it (one of modules).

scenarios.description: Each scenario (cell) of the campaign, its arms and its parameters.

arms.description: The arms (protocols) the data must carry ##RUN## rows for.

parameters.description: The harness flags of this cell, by name (as in its ##CONFIG##); {} when the pre-registration file gives them.

preregistration.description: The plan written before the run: a file in the run directory (listed in files) or a pinned URL (a blob at a commit, or an issue).

seeds.description: The RngRun values every arm of every scenario ran (golden rule 6: paired, >= 20).

commands.description: The exact command lines run, in order (dispatch and harness).

markers.description: The marker-line contract the data follows: a version in schemas/markers/.

files.description: Every file of the run directory except manifest.json, with its sha256. A cell holds marker lines and names its scenario.

supersedes.description: A correction names the run it replaces and the issue that says why (golden rule 10).

notes.description: Free text: anything a reader needs that no field holds.

relpath.description: A path inside the run directory: relative, no '..', no leading '/'.
